Four Verizon Prepaid Unlimited lines cost **$180/mo** without Auto Pay, before taxes and fees. I calculated that figure because I couldn't switch Auto Pay off on the page.

The Auto Pay checkbox on the prepaid plans page (verizon.com/plans/prepaid/) kept showing as checked after repeated clicks. Here is how I got to $180:
- With 4 lines and Auto Pay on, the page shows Unlimited at **$140/mo**, which is $35 per line.
- The page says Auto Pay saves $10/mo per line, so removing it adds $40: $140 + $40 = **$180/mo**.
- This matches the page's single-line price, which is $50 with Auto Pay and so $60 without. Four lines at $60 is $240, less the $60 multiline discount the page lists for 4 lines, which is also $180.

The first month is billed at $60/mo per line before the multiline discount, as the page shows.
